name: How important is seawall condition when evaluating a waterfront property?

mainEntity.name: How important is seawall condition when evaluating a waterfront property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The condition of the seawall is very important when evaluating a waterfront property, as it protects the land from erosion and water intrusion. A damaged or poorly maintained seawall can lead to significant repair costs and potential structural issues for the home. A thorough inspection by a qualified marine contractor is essential to assess its integrity and estimate any necessary repairs, impacting your overall investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Seawall condition is crucial for protecting the property from erosion. A marine contractor inspection is vital to assess integrity and potential repair costs.
